PLAN YOUR REQUIREMENT

A useful brief.
A clearer next step.

Projects requiring coordinated design, multiple manufacturing processes, finishing and assembly.

Decisions to make early

Define the final deliverable, current project stage and approval responsibilities. Identify cost, timing or process challenges so they can be discussed in the context of the complete project.

What to agree before work begins

Agree the scope, review milestones, responsibilities, documentation and acceptance process for each stage.

BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Questions,
answered.

Can one brief include several manufacturing processes?+

Yes. Include the complete product or assembly requirement rather than only individual parts. This allows design, fabrication, machining, finishing and assembly dependencies to be reviewed together.

How should I describe a cost-reduction project?+

Share the current design, expected quantities and the functions that must be preserved. Identify known material, assembly or process concerns and any restrictions on changing the design.

A CLEAR START

What to share.

Project scope, current challenges, quantities and your delivery plan.

Technical scope, material suitability, tolerances, inspection criteria, pricing and timing are confirmed after reviewing your requirements.
